title: Why Dishes Make Your Fingertips Feel Oversensitive
caption:
Hot water turns your fingertips into glitchy sensors
A guy scrubs plates under steaming water, then a skin diagram shows his swollen skin cells driving his nerve receptors crazy - final diagnosis: fingers temporarily oversensitive.
Hot water swells your outer skin cells, and with friction the nerve receptors in your fingertips misfire - the weird feeling fades once your skin dries.
Do your pruny fingertips stop your touchscreen from listening after the dishes?
Save this for your next sink session and follow for more daily body science.
